notes.title: Version 1.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
That's right ladies, and gents, Bug Attack! has been updated. There are a couple of small changes, so let's just get into them.

1. Building Damage
A lot of you didn't like that bugs could cause damage from emerging under the building- so we've gone ahead and reinforced the foundation. ;)

2. New Creature
A new creature has appeared! This colorful caterpillar-thing will occasionally meander across the screen. Squishing these guys will net you bonus points, so keep an eye out- but don't get too distracted.

3. Windowed Gameplay Screen
To better facilitate streaming and video recording, Bug Attack! now launches in a resizable window.

That's it for this time, have fun!

-Dave Vogt
